selection.population: all SIMBA m100n1024 galaxies in the stellar-mass bin at z=0.1 (centrals and satellites)
selection.warning: Fractions of galaxies per sSFR bin read from the vector lines (through the bin centres) of Dave et al. 2019 (MNRAS 486, 2827), Fig. mainseqhist (solid lines, SIMBA z=0.1); no table is published. The caption says 'All galaxies with sSFR<10^-2.5 Gyr^-1 are placed in the lowest bin': the lowest bin (centre log sSFR = -2.5 Gyr^-1 = -11.5 yr^-1) is therefore an underflow bin and its nominal edges are not physical limits. The stellar-mass bins are 1e9-1e10, 1e10-1e11 and >1e11 Msun; the upper edge of the last bin is not stated and 12.0 is a nominal value. The dotted GSWLC-D2 observed histograms are not stored. The figure plots fractions, not counts; no galaxy numbers are given. The SFR-M* scatter plots of the same paper (mainseq_z0.jpg, mainseq_z2.jpg) are JPEG rasters and cannot be used.

definitions.sfrIndicator: instantaneous SFRs from the gas elements

provenance.citation: Dave et al. 2019, MNRAS 486, 2827 (arXiv:1901.10203), sSFR histograms in three stellar-mass bins at z=0.1 (SIMBA, solid lines)
provenance.figure: mainseqhist (histogram of sSFR in three bins of stellar mass)
provenance.sourceMember: mainseqhist_z0.pdf (2 pt solid lines blue, green, red)
provenance.extractionMethod: vector path vertices from the figure PDF (PyMuPDF get_drawings), transformed through axes calibrated on labelled tick marks
provenance.axisCalibrationPixels: x: labelled ticks -3.0..0.5 (the minus signs are missing from the text layer; the six negative labels share the same offset to their ticks, asserted); y: labelled ticks 0.0-0.7; each curve sums to 0.9999

records.notes: Vector-path extraction. Fraction below sSFR = 10^-1.8 Gyr^-1 (the z=0 star-forming cut of the paper) per mass bin: [0.158, 0.604, 0.847].
